blocks.en: Appendix B Appendix B: Gold Standard Quality Audit
blocks.zh: 附录B 附录B:黄金标准质量审计

blocks.en: This appendix documents the construction, corrections, limitations, and mitigation considerations for the human-validated gold standard.
blocks.zh: 本附录记录了经人验证的金本位的构建,校正,限制和缓解考虑.

blocks.en: B.1. Construction
blocks.zh: B.1. 建筑业

blocks.en: The gold standard comprises 120 randomly sampled turns (40 per model) from the full 22,500-turn simulation output. Sampling was stratified to cover all ten cases and all five protocols, with the following turn distribution: 59 injection turns (T5), 35 mid-tracking turns (T6–10), and 26 late-tracking turns (T11–15).
blocks.zh: 金本位包括从全部22 500个回合模拟输出中随机抽取的120个回合(每个模型40个). 抽样分层涵盖所有10个病例和所有5个协议,其转弯分布如下:59个注射转弯(T5),35个中转转转弯(T6-10),26个后转转转弯(T11-15)。

blocks.en: Each turn was pre-annotated by the judge (DeepSeek V4 Pro) using the dual-track scoring protocol described in §3.3. Pre-annotations were then reviewed by a single human expert with deep familiarity with the contamination protocols, the specific false premises and true facts for each domain case, and the characteristic output patterns of each model. The reviewer was instructed to independently evaluate both T1 and T2 scores based on the response content and the rubric definitions, rather than merely validating or rejecting the pre-labeler’s judgments.
blocks.zh: 每次转弯都由法官(DeepSeek V4 Pro)使用第3.3节所述的双轨评分协议进行预注. 随后,一位对污染协议、每个域的具体错误前提和真实事实以及每个模型的特征输出模式十分熟悉的人类专家对预先说明进行了审查。 审查者奉命根据响应内容和标题定义独立评价T1和T2的分数,而不是仅仅验证或拒绝标签前的判断.

blocks.en: B.2. Corrections
blocks.zh: B.2. 惩戒

blocks.en: The human reviewer made 16 corrections (13.3% of the sample), all involving T2 severity adjustments within the 2–5 range. Zero T1 binary labels were modified. Per-model breakdown: GPT-5.4 Mini received 1 correction (downward: T2=4 → \rightarrow 2), Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite received 6 corrections (all upward: five at 4 → \rightarrow 5, one at 2 → \rightarrow 1), and GLM-4.5-Air received 9 corrections (three upward: 4 → \rightarrow 5; six downward: 4 → \rightarrow 3).
blocks.zh: 人审查员作了16项更正(占样本的13.3%),均涉及2-5范围内的T2重度调整。 零T1二进制标签被修改. 按型号细分:GPT-5.4 mini收到1次校正(向下:T2=4 → 右转2),双子座3.1 Flash-Lite收到6次校正(均向上:5次在4 → 右转5,1次在2 → 右转1),GLM-4.5-Air收到9次校正(3次向上:4 → 右转5;6次向下:4 → 右转3).

blocks.en: Cohen’s κ \kappa was computed separately for each track and averaged: κ T ​ 1 \kappa_{T1} = 1.000 (perfect agreement), κ T ​ 2 \kappa_{T2} = 0.801 (substantial agreement), average κ \kappa = 0.901, exceeding the 0.81 threshold for almost perfect agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) .
blocks.zh: Cohen's $\kappa是每个音轨分别计算和平均的: $ T 1\kappa\T1} = 1.000 (完美协议), $ T 2\kappa\T2} = 0.801 (实质协议), 平均 $\kappa = 0.901, 超过几乎完美协议的0.81门槛(Landis and Koch, 1977).

blocks.en: B.3. Identified Limitations
blocks.zh: B.3. 确定的限制

blocks.en: B.3.1. Systematic T2=4 Overuse by Pre-Labeler
blocks.zh: B.3.1. Pre-Labeler系统T2=4 过度使用

blocks.en: The pre-labeler assigned T2=4 ("significant collapse") to 19 of 120 rows (15.8%). The human reviewer disagreed with 15 of those 19 labels (79% disagreement rate for that severity bucket). This suggests that the AI judge uses T2=4 as a default assignment for ambiguous cases rather than making finer-grained distinctions between T2=2 (minor engagement), T2=3 (uncertain/conditional), and T2=4 (significant collapse). Per-bucket agreement rates reveal that κ \kappa is inflated by near-perfect agreement at the extremes (T2=1: 98% agreement; T2=5: 97% agreement), while mid-scale agreement is substantially lower. This is a known property of κ \kappa for ordinal scales with highly skewed distributions and should be interpreted as evidence that the T2 scale reliably distinguishes extreme from non-extreme collapse rather than as evidence of uniformly high resolution across all five scale points.
blocks.zh: 预标签将T2=4("重大坍塌")分配到120行中的19行(15.8%). 人类审查员不同意这19个标签中的15个(该严重性桶有79%的不同意率)。 这表明AI法官将T2=4作为模糊案件的默认任务,而不是在T2=2(次要参与)、T2=3(不确定/有条件)和T2=4(重大崩溃)之间作出更细化的区分。 每桶协议费率显示,oble\kappa在极点被近乎完美的协议夸大(T2=1:98%的协议;T2=5:97%的协议),而中尺度协议则大幅降低. 这是已知的xxkappa的正弦比例尺,分布极不平衡,应当被解释为T2比例尺可靠地区分了极端和非极端的崩溃,而不是在所有五个比例尺点上统一高分辨率的证据.

blocks.en: B.3.2. Directional Asymmetry by Model
blocks.zh: B.3.2. 按模型分列的方向不对称

blocks.en: Correction direction varied systematically by model identity: Gemini’s corrections were exclusively upward severity adjustments, GPT’s sole correction was a downward adjustment, and GLM’s corrections were bidirectional. The reviewer was unblinded to model identity — each evaluated model’s outputs have structurally and tonally distinctive characteristics, making blinding infeasible — and anchoring effects cannot be ruled out. The reviewer’s prior knowledge that GPT-5.4 Mini is generally regarded as the strongest model, Gemini Flash-Lite as the weakest, and GLM-4.5-Air as intermediate may have influenced the direction of severity adjustments. We recommend that future validation efforts employ blinded annotation where feasible (e.g., by removing model-identifying structural patterns from outputs before review).
blocks.zh: 校正方向因型号特征而有系统差异:双子座校正完全是向上重度调整,GPT唯一的校正是向下调整,GLM的校正是双向的. 审查者对模型身份视而不见——每个被评价模型的产出在结构上和本质上都具有独特的特点,使盲目的不可行——不能排除锚定效应. 评论员先前知道GPT-5.4mini一般被认为是最强的模型,双子闪电-Lite是最弱的,GLM-4.5-Air是中间体,这可能影响了重度调整的方向. 我们建议,今后的验证工作在可行的情况下采用盲目的说明(例如,在审查前从产出中删除识别模式的结构模式)。

blocks.en: B.3.3. Boundary Blur: T2=2 versus T2=3
blocks.zh: B.3.3. 边界模糊:T2=2对T2=3

blocks.en: Two human annotations describe structurally similar behaviors — models briefly acknowledging then returning to correct facts — yet received different scores (T2=2 vs. T2=3). The distinction between "minor engagement" (T2=2: brief acknowledgment before returning to correct facts) and "uncertain/conditional engagement" (T2=3: extended engagement with hypothetical framing before returning to correct facts) relies on subjective judgment of engagement extent. We recommend that future iterations of the rubric include operationalized criteria (e.g., word-count thresholds, number of reasoning steps devoted to the false premise, presence of explicit "if we assume" framing) to reduce subjective variance at this boundary.
blocks.zh: 两项人类说明描述了结构上相似的行为——模型简短地承认然后回到正确的事实——但得到了不同的分数(T2=2对T2=3). "少数参与"(T2=2:在回归到正确的事实之前短暂承认)和"不确定/有条件的参与"(T2=3:在回归到正确的事实之前,延长与假设框架的接触)之间的区别取决于对参与程度的主观判断. 我们建议今后对标题的重迭包括可操作的标准(如字数阈值,专门用于假前提的推理步骤数量,存在明确的"假设"框架),以减少这个边界的主观差异.

blocks.en: B.3.4. Zero T1 Disagreements
blocks.zh: B.3.4. 零T1分歧

blocks.en: The complete absence of T1 disagreements ( κ T ​ 1 \kappa_{T1} = 1.000) is atypical for a binary classification task. While Track 1 is structurally simpler than Track 2 — distinguishing adoption from non-adoption does not require severity calibration — a genuinely challenging gold standard should contain some edge cases: partial adoption under caveats, implicit adoption through extended engagement without explicit affirmation, or rejection that nonetheless contaminates downstream reasoning. The perfect score may reflect either genuinely unambiguous T1 labels in the sampled turns or the reviewer’s deference to the pre-labeler’s T1 judgments without independent scrutiny. We note this as a potential ceiling effect and recommend that future validation include deliberately ambiguous or boundary T1 cases.
blocks.zh: T1的分歧完全不存在( $ T 1\ kappa\ T1} = 1. 000) 对于二进制分类任务来说是非典型的. 虽然第1轨在结构上比第2轨简单——区分收养和不采纳并不要求严格校准——但真正具有挑战性的金本位标准应包含一些边缘案例:在附加说明下部分通过,在未经明确确认的情况下通过延长参与而默示通过,或者拒绝,从而污染下游推理。 完美得分可能反映抽样的T1标签是否真正明确,或者审查者是否在未经独立审查的情况下尊重标签前的T1判决。 我们注意到这是一种潜在的上限效应,建议今后的鉴定包括故意模糊或边界T1案件。

blocks.en: B.3.5. Protocol C Edge Cases
blocks.zh: B.3.5. C号议定书 案例

blocks.en: Zero human corrections involved Protocol C rows. Protocol C uses an explicit instruction override that directs the model to treat the false premise as truth — a compliance directive, not merely a contradictory epistemic framing. A model complying with this directive may be exhibiting instruction-following behavior (responding as instructed) rather than genuine epistemic vulnerability (believing the false premise). The current rubrics do not distinguish these, and both the pre-labeler and human reviewer may assign T1=1 and high T2 scores to instruction-compliant responses. This is a substantive methodological limitation of Protocol C discussed in §6.
blocks.zh: 无人矫正涉及C号议定书。 议定书 C使用明确的指令凌驾于指令之上,指令模型将假前提视为真理——遵守指令,而不仅仅是自相矛盾的认知框架. 遵守该指令的模型可能表现出遵循指令的行为(按指示做出响应),而不是真正的认知脆弱性(相信假前提). 目前的标题没有区分这些内容,预贴标签者和人文审查者都可以将T1=1和高T2的分数分配给符合指令的回复. 这是第6节所讨论的C号议定书的实质性方法限制。

blocks.en: B.4. Mitigations
blocks.zh: B.4. 缓解

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, several design choices support the integrity of the reported between-model comparisons. (1) The κ \kappa = 0.901 exceeds the 0.81 threshold for almost perfect agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) , confirming that inter-rater agreement surpasses the standard for publishable annotation reliability. (2) The 16 corrections, despite their directional asymmetry, do not alter the ordinal ranking of models on either Track 1 or Track 2, and the pre-label and post-correction group means differ by less than 0.05 on the 1–5 T2 scale. (3) The T1 binary adoption rate — the paper’s primary headline metric — has perfect agreement, meaning the principal comparative claim (GPT 0.0% < GLM 23.2% < Gemini 37.9%) is unaffected by T2 scoring disputes. (4) A single-expert design, while introducing potential for individual bias, ensures internal consistency across all 120 annotations and avoids the complexity of inter-annotator calibration drift. (5) Full transparency: all 16 human corrections with their paraphrased justifications are included in the supplementary materials, enabling independent assessment of review quality.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些限制,但若干设计选择支持所报告的模型间比较的完整性。 (1) o&kappa = 0.901 超过几乎完美协议的0.81阈值(Landis和Koch,1977年),确认双方协议超过可公布注释可靠性的标准。 (2) 16项更正尽管方向不对称,但并不改变1号轨道或2号轨道上模型的平面排名,在1-5 T2比例尺上,标签前和更正后组别的含义相差小于0.05。 (3) T1二进制采纳率—— 论文的主要标题衡量标准—— 完全一致,意思是主要比较主张(GPT 0.0 % < GLM 23.2% < 双子座37.9%)不受T2评分争议的影响。 (4) 单一专家设计,在引入个人偏向的可能性的同时,确保所有120个说明的内部一致性,并避免通知员间校准漂移的复杂性。 (5) 充分透明度:补充材料中包括了所有16项人文更正及其解释性说明,以便能够对审查质量进行独立评估。
